_about: YTT cleanup rules. Edit by hand, no rebuild needed, YTT reloads it on the next dictation. Set any rule to false to switch it off.
_dictionary_help: Each entry: 'to' is the correct spelling. 'from' lists wrong spellings to replace (whole words, any case). Without 'from', the word is matched case-insensitively and its casing fixed. Every 'to' is also sent to the speech model as a hotword (needs a relaunch). Add your own name and the products or people you mention often.
